subtitle: Sovereign Ascension — Unified Character Intelligence

Added character mission and progression workflows with linked steps, local JSON export and source-aware status guidance.
Expanded ZevRo | Azeroth Assistant 2.0 with an opt-in evidence review explaining manual, official and unavailable information without generative AI or account-token access.
Added mobile-first Sovereign Dashboard presentation, source-labeled metrics, safe JSON preview/import, optional public fetch and explicit cancellation.
All existing Cloudflare authentication, music, Founder, local save keys and 7.x research studios remain untouched; real-game acceptance remains pending.
Updated Gateway, Getting Started, Player Handbook, developer test checklist, device QA, changelog, regression checks and non-triggering Discord draft.
